title: Average Calculator
seoTitle: Average Calculator — Mean, Median and Mode
description: Paste numbers to get the mean, median, mode, sum and count. Commas and new lines are both accepted, and the calculation stays in the browser.
intro: Enter a list of numbers separated by commas, spaces or new lines. The tool reports count, sum, mean, median and every mode.
blurb: Calculate mean, median, mode, sum and count from a list of numbers.
howItWorks: Tokens are split on commas, spaces and line breaks, then parsed as decimals.
Mean is the sum divided by the count. Median uses the middle value or the average of the two middle values.
Mode lists every value that appears most often. If every value appears once, there is no mode.
examples: 1 2 3 4 has median 2.5 because there are two middle numbers.
A blank line between numbers is ignored.

faq.a: Yes. A leading minus is part of the number. Other characters make that token invalid.
Results are rounded to four decimal places when they are not whole numbers.
